negative_reviews.author: Katrina D
negative_reviews.text: We ordered from Deliveroo and the packaging was great! They have separated the soup with the noodles and other ingredients. They also placed it in a thermal bag. The only comment that I have is that the soup was too little for the noodles… therefore, it ended up a bit dry. If they fix the balance, it would be perfect.
